name: Patrick Smart Dumb
look: Two stacked SpongeBob SquarePants stills. Top: Patrick Star in glasses, a white lab coat and red tie peers into a microscope and takes notes in a rocky lab. Bottom: Patrick sits on the sand with a wooden plank nailed to his head, holding a hammer beside a bench with a saw and scattered tools.
use: Contrasts a smart version of something with a dumb version. The top panel gets the clever, competent take and the bottom gets the clueless reality, such as how you think you work versus how you actually work.
slots: the smart version, on the top panel (lab Patrick)
the dumb version, on the bottom panel (plank-on-head Patrick)
examples: Me explaining my plan in my head
Me in the first five minutes of the exam
Me in the last five minutes
